Caiaphas Angry That Christ Confesses He Is the Christ

Richard Crashaw (G.) (c. 1613–1649)

W
ROTH
 that the Christ confesseth Christ He is!
His fault that He is but Himself I wis
Thee shall I reckon priest? Strange priest is he
Who leaves not God His own Divinity.
